assets.cg_ep_mina_screen_v1.png:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserve.
Asset type: finished 16:9 anime visual-novel ending CG for the existing game Refrain. Output a single landscape illustration, ideally 1672x941 or 1920x1080.
Input images: image 1 (cg_ep_goodbye_v2) is the edit target and character/art-style reference; image 2 (op_phone_v1) is the exact existing smartphone hardware reference; image 3 (cg_ep_mina_sky_v3) is only the night-sky color and moon reference.
Primary request: correct the story continuity. MINA is an AI living INSIDE the smartphone display, never a physical person standing outside. Replace the rooftop scene with an intimate view of that black smartphone, clearly visible device bezel, resting upright on a simple dark unobtrusive surface. MINA appears ONLY as the image inside its glass display. Outside the device: soft indistinct dark blue surroundings, no exterior location, no people, no invented room decoration.
Composition: cinematic landscape. A large smartphone occupies the right-center, roughly x=45%-84%, y=5%-94%. Show its complete top and side bezels and a small bottom edge. Keep MINA's whole head with maid headband and her face in the upper 60% of the canvas, large and legible, enough margin from the phone top. Lower 24% is reserved for the game's dialogue panel. Left third stays quiet, dark and softly illuminated by the device. The display shows her from mid torso upward with a gentle relieved smile and one hand relaxed near her chest, facing the viewer. Inside the display behind MINA is a simple deep blue night-sky wallpaper with a small moon and a few stars, clearly flat screen wallpaper with very subtle translucent panel edges; NO rooftop, railing, floor, landscape horizon, or physical exterior. Her hair, hands and clothes must be wholly contained within the screen, no hologram or body outside it.
Identity invariants: retain the same MINA from image 1: long silver-white hair with lavender shadows, blue eyes, white ruffled maid headband, navy dress and white apron, navy neck ribbon with rectangular blue gem. Same soft polished anime shading and emotional warmth, natural adult proportions, no chibi. Keep the screen glass and frame visibly separating her from the viewer. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, subtitles, game UI, extra characters. A restrained calming blue screen glow, realistic coherent phone geometry.

Input image 1 is the edit target: the new MINA-inside-smartphone CG. Input image 2 is a supporting reference for MINA's original gentle farewell expression and the dawn colors.
Create a matched variant of image 1 for the very last conversation. Preserve EXACTLY the same landscape framing, camera, device position and size, black smartphone bezel and screen boundary, dark indistinct surroundings and simple surface. MINA remains wholly contained inside the glass display, never outside it. Keep her silver-white long hair, blue eyes, same headband, navy-and-white maid dress, blue rectangular neck gem, face identity, and painting style.
Change only: give MINA a slightly warmer, contented soft smile, a small relaxed tilt of her head and her hand gently resting flat at her chest; inside the device change the night-sky wallpaper to the muted blue/lavender/soft peach early dawn sky from image 2, without a landscape or rooftop, with only a faint moon remaining. The ambient screen glow can warm subtly. Keep the surrounding real-world area dark and quiet. Do not brighten the entire scene.
Her complete head and face remain in the same upper area, clear above the bottom 24% reserved for dialogue. Retain the visible top and side frame so her digital existence is unmistakable. No body or hair can cross the phone frame. No people outside the phone, no text, letters, logos, subtitles, UI overlays, holograms, rooftop, railing, buildings or new room decoration. Single finished landscape image matching the original aspect ratio.
